notes:
Account snapshot: LoomBridge builds a multi-tenant conversational agent platform for SMB+ mid-market customers (help center + automated triage + L2 assist). Evaluating Hosted API as fast path, then Dedicated for predictable latency and per-tenant isolation. Key ask: streaming stability + per-tenant quotas and throttles (want per-organization token/QPS caps, burst behavior).

Highlights from discovery:
- 2026-02-20 intro: product lead said 'need streaming that doesn't drop events under load' — cohort of 200 tenants, peak concurrencies ~600 sessions.
- They use tool-calling heavily (internal search / tickets / billing lookup) — model must support fast tool-call round trips and structured output. Prefer function/tool calling semantics.
- Latency SLO: p95 live-stream end-to-end 150–300ms for short replies (10–60 tokens); willing to accept higher for long-form. Batch ops (reranking/embeddings) are lower priority.
- Cost sensitivity: mid-market unit economics tight; they want Redwood Optimize recommendations (batching, quantization) to shave per-session cost.

POC ask / criteria:
1) 48h POC on Hosted API streaming with synthetic traffic from their load generator (we agreed to mirror tenant QPS profile). Check for dropped events, reconnect behavior, and per-tenant throttling.
2) Demo of tool-calling in streaming mode (two-step: model->tool->model) with measurable latency numbers.
3) Show how Dedicated would look: predicted throughput at commit, autoscale behavior, fallback to hosted in region outages.
4) Security: SSO for admin, audit logs for agent messages, and KMS integration for keys.

Commercial notes:
- Interested in blended pricing: hosted for early tenants, Dedicated once >X concurrency. They asked for a pricing worksheet comparing hosted vs reserved GPU cost for 12/24/36 month commits (Drive doc linked).
- ARR target: $150k–300k first-year if SLA and quotas are acceptable.

Talk fragments / internal AE notes:
- "If streaming stalls under our peak we lose customers" (CTO).
- Legal: residency questions for EU customers — may require VPC/private later.
- Ops: wants per-tenant dashboards, per-route token cost breakdown.

Open technical questions for SE to validate:
- How are streaming reconnects handled? backfill of missed tokens?
- Can we enforce strict per-tenant QPS + token caps with graceful 429/429 headers and telemetry?
- Behavior of tool-calling when model fallback occurs (consistency of tool invocation).

Stubs/links: fireflies and drive docs above. Jira ticket RDW-4123 created for streaming flakiness test plan.

Next actions (short):
- SE (Carlos) to produce POC runbook + synthetic load scripts by 2026-03-05.
- Maya to confirm billing model options with pricing team and send worksheet.
- Schedule 48h POC kickoff meeting (ff_20260301_poc_kickoff).
